annotation.title_clean: AILA: Evaluación del Panorama de la Inteligencia Artificial en Colombia
annotation.title_en: AILA: Artificial Intelligence Landscape Assessment of Colombia
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Programa de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo (PNUD) Colombia
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNDP Colombia's AI Landscape Assessment (AILA, Nov 2024) rates Colombia's AI readiness at 3.4/5 ("Differentiator"). It assesses government as enabler, government as user, and ethical AI use, and recommends integrated AI governance, advanced infrastructure planning, digital skills, data quality and ethics-compliance mechanisms. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Colombia scores 3.4/5 overall AI readiness, 'Differentiator' level.
Recommends an integrated government AI governance model with monitoring and compliance verification.
Calls for a National Plan for advanced AI infrastructure and stronger digital skills.
Highlights gaps in connectivity, data quality, and interoperability platform implementation.
Notes the ethical framework lacks mechanisms to verify compliance and promote cultural diversity.
